profile_text.body:
Pegasystems Inc is a public company headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, and trades under the ticker PEGA. Its site describes it as an AI-powered platform for enterprise transformation, and says organizations use it to automate workflows, personalize customer experiences, and modernize legacy systems. The company states it has worked in this area since 1983 and that the world's largest organizations have trusted it to turn transformation ambitions into results.

The site's current emphasis is Infinity 26, described as the company's latest platform release, designed to help enterprises build, orchestrate, and scale AI with predictability, control, and measurable value. Pega Platform is presented as unifying AI for mission-critical work, and the company says its AI agents operate with context, compliance, and human oversight so customers can orchestrate an agentic workforce end to end. Pega Blueprint is described as an AI-powered workspace that brings business and IT together with governance and established best practices. The company calls its architecture key to unlocking scale and continuous evolution.

Company records list a SEC CIK of 0001013857. Litigation exposure is listed in Massachusetts, with 176 cases.
